Using starter code form slide 6. This is from lecture two in week 3. Need to load necessray libraries first. 

```{r}
library(tsibble)
library(fable)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(tsibbledata)
library(glue)
library(ggplot2)
```

Lets build the starter dataframe and grab the data that comes into the fable package. 

```{r}
# forecast horizon
H <- 4
WIN <- 240
# First origin: 20 years of monthly data
INIT <- 240

cafes <- aus_retail |>
  filter(
    State == "Victoria",
    Industry == "Cafes, restaurants and catering services"
  )

origins_roll <- cafes |>
  slide_tsibble(.size = WIN, .step = 1)

tscv_roll_fc <- origins_roll |>
  model(mean = MEAN(Turnover),
        snaive = SNAIVE(Turnover),
        drift = RW(Turnover ~ drift()),
        tslm = TSLM(Turnover ~ trend() + season())) |>
  forecast(h = H) |>
  filter(Month <= max(cafes$Month)) |>
  group_by(.id, .model) |> mutate(h = row_number()) |> ungroup() |>
  as_fable(response = "Turnover", distribution = Turnover)

  
errs <- tscv_roll_fc |>
  filter(h == 1) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(as_tibble(cafes) |> select(Month, actual = Turnover),
    by = "Month") |>
mutate(e = actual - .mean) |>
select(Month, .model, e) |>
pivot_wider(names_from = .model, values_from = e)

head(errs)

```

Now lets do the DM test. 

```{r}
forecast::dm.test(errs$snaive, errs$drift, h = 1, power = 1)
```
